title: An accessible vault with help from a family member
description: Large text, actions you can follow and a way to get help agreed in advance.

blocks.text: A user in a review values not having to keep a pile of passwords in his head. Age on its own does not determine the interface that is needed. Large text, legible labels and a calm order of actions are worth testing with the people who find the existing vault awkward; help from a family member is set up separately.

quote.text: I’m soon to be 80 and I would be totally lost without robo I work with many banks in my office.   Anyone starting to forget, this is the best thing in the world and Works every time.

blocks.text: Make searching and telling entries apart simpler, and test text enlargement and screen reading. Set up separately how much help the chosen person is allowed to give.
Do not replace convenience with handing every secret to a relative. A person has to understand the limits of the help and stay in control of their own archive.
